text:
tyler_perf: quick heads-up — canary with FlashAttention2 landed on prod pool, but we're seeing a tokens/sec regression for short-chat workloads (~1-2 turns).

elaine_ml: saw that in the dashboard too. raw numbers?

tyler_perf: on rtx-pool-7, 512-context median tokens/sec dropped from 23.1k -> 20.1k (≈13%). cost jumped from $18.5/M -> $21.9/M.

maddy_runtime: hmm that's sizable. did kernel selection flip to fa2 always, or only for quantized paths?

tyler_perf: FA2 chosen for fp16 and 4-bit q4 variants by heuristics. but profiler shows a lot more kernel-switch events during request lifetime. suspects: KV cache eviction + fallback to paged attention on some shards.

samir_p: can you paste the profiler snippet?

tyler_perf: pasted below (trimmed):

```
[2026-03-15 10:12:03] request id=fx-9u: kernel=flash2, seq_len=512, kv_mem_use=93%
[2026-03-15 10:12:03] request id=fx-9u: batch_window_ms=12, batch_sz=3
[2026-03-15 10:12:03] scheduler: decided kernel=fused for shard-2 (eviction predicted)
[2026-03-15 10:12:03] runtime: switched kernel -> paged-attn on shard-2 (evict triggered)
[2026-03-15 10:12:03] kv-cache: partial-evict, io-wait=1.4ms, extra-copy=0.9ms
[2026-03-15 10:12:03] request id=fx-9u: tokens/sec (end-to-end)=11.8k (single shard slow)
```

elaine_ml: that extra-copy/io-wait looks suspicious. are we serializing copies when switching kernels?

maddy_runtime: switching between FA2 and paged-attn currently does a KV buffer reformat because their cache layouts differ. we added that to avoid correctness bugs. but it costs ~1ms per switch.

samir_p: what's the distribution of batch sizes? I suspect lots of small batches causing more switches per second.

tyler_perf: yeah skewed: 60% batch=1, 30% batch=2, 10% batch>=4. small batches + high kv pressure -> frequent fallback sampling.

oleg_ops: how often does eviction hysteresis trigger? where's the threshold?
maddy_runtime: threshold is 95% mem_util with hysteresis 2% (so re-enable when <93%). But prediction model uses instantaneous peak during batch assembly which is noisy.

tyler_perf: concrete repro: run short chat sim with p(continue)=0.35 per token (to simulate many short turns). FA2 path shows 11-14% worse tokens/sec vs fused baseline due to ~0.8-1.2ms extra per-switch + higher kernel launch overhead for tiny batches.

samir_p: mitigation ideas?

maddy_runtime: options: 1) increase hysteresis window to 5% and use rolling avg over 100ms, reduce flip-flopping; 2) keep FA2 format but add compatible KV layout to avoid reformat (costly impl); 3) bias kernel selector to prefer fused for batch_sz<=2 or latency-sensitive classes; 4) aggressive prefix caching to reduce eviction.

elaine_ml: do we have $/M model to surface tradeoffs for customers? Ops wants a short blurb if we roll back.

tyler_perf: quick delta I computed: for the affected slice (short-chat, batch<=2) tokens/sec -13%, cost +18% (driven by lower throughput + identical infra cost). Overall pool-level impact ~+3% $/M because long-form workloads unaffected.

samir_p: I'd prefer short-term: tweak selector (option 3) + increase hysteresis (option 1). longer term: option 2 (KV compatibility) but that's infra work.

oleg_ops: can we add a canary gate: only enable FA2 for batch>=3 or estimated kv_util <90%?
maddy_runtime: yes. I'll push a config change to canary: selector_policy.v2 = { min_batch_for_fa2: 3, kv_util_upper: 0.9, hysteresis_pct: 5 }.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by maddy_runtime for config change config/selector_canary.yaml -> canary on rtx-pool-7.

tyler_perf: thanks. after the change, let's monitor tokens/sec, kernel-switch events, and paged-attn invocation rate. If we still see regression, next step is to prototype compatible KV layout.

elaine_ml: also add a perf regression alert that triggers if tokens/sec drops >7% for that short-chat slice for 10m.

samir_p: adding note: this problem shows how micro-behavior (batch size dist + kv pressure) changes unit economics. good call to tie perf metrics to $/M in dashboards.

tyler_perf: agreed — will add a quick chart to the rollout PR.

maddy_runtime: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rt-runtime/pulls/1428 (selector canary + metric hooks). please review.

samir_p: lgtm after minor naming nit.

oleg_ops: keeping an eye. thx all :thumbsup:
